chapters: Ba' jix aa' ka't mi' dhɨr koi'm gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu duukam gu Moisees jix koi; gio ba' bamii' jano' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu Jordaan tu' bɨx dhi' gu ja'tkam gu oidha' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' tu' dhagia' na ja'p ka't tu ñi'ook gu Moisees bɨx pai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaas tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' dɨr oidha' jix gaki dhi' gu Liibano bɨɨx ka'm gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Euprates bɨx gu oidha' gu eteos bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ' suudai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tas ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' soo'mchulhdhak tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui jix bhai'x bɨx gu tanoolh gu oidha'; gio ba' na ja'p tu' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu Moisees jix duñia' bɨndak; mi' dhɨr cham tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix kavɨk; na gu' tu' dhi' gu ja'tkam gu maa'nkar gu oidha' tattat.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu bhóogɨt jix kavɨk na ba' duñia' jurtu'nka' bɨx ñi'ook na tu a'ga tu duukam gu Moisees tu' jix aa'ñdhix; gio ba' cham tu' gu ñi'ook tu' kɨɨ'n tu' na ba' bɨx tu'x.

Jano' ba' u'uan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na tu a'ga cham pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu chin; gio ba' va'k gu tanoolh gu tukaa' na ba' nukadham jurtu'nka' bɨx ua'nak; na gu' jano' ba' jix duu gu bhóogɨt bɨx tu' xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix kavɨk; na gu' cham jum i'obh tu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨndak pai'.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee jix aa'ñdhix gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam bham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ yooxi' gu ja'tkam bham; gio ba' gu Prebeniios jugi; na gu' gu ñi'ook vaik gu tanoolh gu Jordaan na ba' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa na ba'.
Ba' jix aa' gio gu Josuee gu Rubenitas gu Gaditas ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees bham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa jɨɨpi'ñka' tu' jix maa dhi' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ a'aalh gu vaakax gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Moisees tu' jix maa dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan; gu' gu ñi'ook bɨx jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix maa jɨɨpi'ñka' gu ja'tkam na ja'p gu ñi'ook gio gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa; gio ba' mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan bhaan pai' gu tas; mi' dhɨr bia'ka'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Josuee bham; gio ba' no'ch chulhiiñchuda' bɨx tu'x jix duñia' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moisees bɨx tu'x tu'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨndak na ja'p ka't bɨɨx gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' no'x ua'tulhi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook cham gu ñi'ook bɨx tu'x gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun bhañ dɨr gu Sittim gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu oidha' gu Jerikoo; mi' dhɨr jix bɨɨx duu baap gu vaak gu u'vɨ ganai' gu Raab gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't jix maa aa'ñdham gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerikoo bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duñia' tɨbiap dhi' gu tukaa' gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerikoo bhañ a'ga gu Raab; gio ba' jix buusñi mai' gu chichio'ñ jix duñia' tɨbiap tu' jix duñia' kia'mi'ñ gu vaak; na gu' jix duñia' tɨbiap gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu oidha'.
Gu' gu' gu u'vɨ ka't jix duñia' gook gu chichio'ñ ka't gu jodai' na jix uam; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu'r gu chichio'ñ tɨɨtɨs tu' gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duukat jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix duu ki'ñgob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix bhai'x jix duñia' gu chichio'ñ moor cham tu' duukat jix duñia'; gio ba' jix duñia'.
Gu' gu' ka't gu ñi'ook jix tɨ'ɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dua'ñ gu jodai' na jix uam tɨjɨɨ'ñ mii' dhɨr ga'ra'.
Jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ jix bɨɨx duu bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt gu Jordaan bɨɨx ka'm; gio ba' ki'ñgob ka't gu ñi'ook mi' dhɨr moor bhaan jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' gu' va'k gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix tɨ'ɨ.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa dhi' gu oidha'; na gu' choo'n gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan no'ch bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n kuiñcha gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix duu na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam naak gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai' gu gɨ' suudai' gu Bermejo vupui bhaan na pai' dhuuk oirɨ gu Ejipto jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gook gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos mi'p baasɨ'n gu Jordaan gu Seoon gu Og jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tɨiñ dhi' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chulhiiñdha' gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ oi'ñdha' kuiñcha; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios jiix gu tɨkɨr gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu ñi'ook xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu vaak gu taat nɨi'ñchudat dhuu.
Jano' ba' dodhia' gu oidha' gu taat gu naan gu ja'tkam sɨspidhi'ñ bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ koi'm.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm koi'm tu' cham dhi' chulhiiñdha'; na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios bhɨɨya' jix maa gu oidha' no'ch chulhiiñchuda' bɨndak xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu'r.
Jano' ba' jix duu jano' ba' jix dhaav bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu vaak ka't vaak jodai.
Ba' jix aa'; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk na gu' jix bɨɨx duu bhaan gu ñi'ook cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr dhi' vaik gu tanoolh bɨɨx ka'm; jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' no'ch duduaka' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na pai' dhuuk no'ch gu oidha' tu' dhi' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' gu vaak gu taat gu naan gu ja'tkam bɨx ja'tkam vaak gu taat.
Jano' ba' no'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mai' kiki'ñgob gu vaak gu ɨ'ɨr ka't bhaan mo'o no'ch cham gu ñi'ook; gu' no'x gu vaak bɨndak gu ɨ'ɨr ka't bhaan mo'o tu' gu novɨ kuichdha'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' chulhiiñdha' no'ch duduaka' dhi' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' ka't na ja'p jix duñia' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bɨɨx duu; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk vaik gu tanoolh bɨɨx ka'm oi'ñchu'; gio ba' bhiadat gu ñi'ook bɨx gu bhóogɨt gu' cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook gu chio'ñ jix dhaav gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook tɨɨtɨs gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun gu ñi'ook bɨx tu'x.
Jano' ba' gui'p gu Josuee; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhagia' bɨx gu oidha' gu novɨ gu noobh; mi' dhɨr gio bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan no'ch.
Jano' ba' jix búup gu Josuee gu xibh gu ñi'ook gu Sittim tɨɨtɨs bɨɨx ka'm gu Jordaan bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam va'k.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaik gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a tɨjɨɨ'ñ yooxi'.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam bham; na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas gu ux na tu ibai' pai' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.

Gu' cham gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't jix bhai'x na ja'p gu ñi'ook gook jix bhai'x; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook dhiñ gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook pai' jix duñia' tu'; na gu' cham jix duñia' va'k jano' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' gu Josuee gu ja'tkam; na gu' jix bhaan na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu xibh tɨjɨɨ'ñ kɨɨ'p.

Ba' jix aa' gu Josuee jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan jix bɨɨx duu vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Josuee; gio ba' dɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh kua'da' jix gɨ' vupui bhaan gu vupui bɨx gu Israeel na ba' kɇɇkɇ' na ja'p jix duñia' bɨɨx gu Moisees jix duñia' bɨndak.

Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ux na tu ibai' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan bham; na pai' dhuuk kia'mi'ñ bɨɨx ka'm jannulhi'ñ gu suudai' gu Jordaan.
Ba' jix aa' gu Josuee gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Josuee; gio ba' dhi' gu Jawatan Dios na jix do'ig tɨjɨɨ'ñ vupui bhaan gu Kananeo gu eteo gu ebeo gu Pereseo gu Gergeseo gu Amorreo gu Jebuseo.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Señoreador bɨx gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu chichio'ñ bopxi'ñ gu Israeel bopxi'ñ maa'n.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu vaas tɨɨt jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ux na tu ibai' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Señoreador bɨx gu oidha' ua'tulhi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu suudai' gu Jordaan gu suudai' gu Jordaan; na gu' gu suudai' jupaabkamu'n jiix gɨ' kavɨk.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam vaak zel na ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' baap gu Jordaan na ja'p tɨɨt jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' jix bɨɨx duu jugii'ñ gu suudai' na gu' gu Jordaan bhaan bɨx gu ñi'ook oraa'.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' aajidha' jiix gu ñi'ook na ja'p gɨ' kavɨk xoi'kam jix duñia' kiicham gu Adam gu ñi'ook gu Saretan; gio ba' jix dhaav gu gɨ' suudai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ' suudai' gu Salado jix bɨɨx duu; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jerikoo.

Gu' gu' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix gaki jiimda' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jordaan bɨɨx ka'm bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan; gio ba' bɨx gu Israeel gu ñi'ook jix gaki.
Ba' jix aa' na pai' dhuuk bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Josuee bham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ bopxi'ñ maa'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jordaan pai' jiimda' tɨɨt jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu jodai bɨɨx gu ñi'ook pai' jix duñia' mambhɨɨx gu tukaa'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Josuee jup tɨɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ ka't jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bopxi'ñ maa'n.

Ba' jix aa' gu Josuee; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jordaan; mi' dhɨr maa'n gu ñi'ook gu jodai bhaan gu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Na ba' na ba' dhi' ka't nɨi'ñchudat tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook; na pai' dhuuk gu ma'nkam tu ñi'ook tattat gu xibh bham; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu jodai.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; na gu suudai' gu Jordaan jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan gu suudai' gu Jordaan; jano' ba' dhi' gu jodai ka't chɨ'ñchoka' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na ba' bɨɨx tas.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duu na ja'p gu Josuee jix aa'ñdhix; na jix búup gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jordaan na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu Josuee jurtu'nka' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook baidhak.

Jano' ba' gu Josuee gio jix búup gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jordaan pai' tɨɨt jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan; gio ba' jix duñia' dhi' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jordaan bɨɨx ka'm jix bɨɨx duu bɨx gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' gu Josuee tu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam jurtu'nka' bɨx tu'x gu Moisees ka't gu Josuee jix duñia'; gio ba' gu ja'tkam jix maa gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk bɨx gu ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook gio kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gio gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen gu ma'nkam gu Gad ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bhaan gu Moisees ka't tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' na ja'p oo'm jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhaan vaak ja'tkam gu Jerikoo vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Josuee gu vupui bɨx gu Israeel; gio ba' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu Moisees bɨx gu tanoolh gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Josuee bham.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ux na tu ibai' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' chuut gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jordaan.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee jix aa'ñdhix jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jordaan.

Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix tɨ'ɨ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jordaan gu vaas tɨɨt jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix gaki gu suudai' gu Jordaan suulh pai' na ja'p va'k bhaan bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam jix tɨ'ɨ gu Jordaan mambhɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n yooxi' gu Gilgal gu ñi'ook gu ux na tu ibai' gu Jerikoo.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Gilgal gu jodai gu Jordaan.
Ba' jix aa' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bham; na pai' dhuuk gu xibh tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam tattat; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu jodai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam bham; gio ba' gu Israeel gu ñi'ook jix gaki dhi' gu Jordaan.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu suudai' gu Jordaan vupui bhaan bɨɨx ka'm dua'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook gu gɨ' suudai' gu Bermejo vupui bhaan no'ch bɨɨx ka'm.
Na ba' na ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios jix kavɨk; na ba' ɨɨbhi'ñdha' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu tanoolh.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos mi'p baasɨ'n gu Jordaan tas gei'ñ bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Kananeos mi'p mia'n gu gɨ' suudai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu suudai' gu Jordaan vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨɨx ka'm a'lhiok gu i'ii'ñ cham ka't gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Josuee; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gookim jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Josuee gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' dhi' kuiñcha gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Josuee; gio ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto gu chio'ñ bɨx gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham jix koi oidha' jix gaki gu bhóogɨt mi' dhɨr moor gu Ejipto.
Na gu' na gu' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook mi'p; gu' bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't maaxir oidha' jix gaki gu bhóogɨt mi' dhɨr moor gu Ejipto cham mi'p.

Na gu' na gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' jix gaki oo'm bɨɨx ka'm bɨx gu ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto ka't na gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook cham gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook tattat pai' bii'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam ka't gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai' gu Josuee; na gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook na gu' cham jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk a'lhiok gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ja'tkam pai' yooxi' bɨɨx ka'm.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Josuee; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ejipto; mi' dhɨr gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr pai' ka't tɨɨgim gu Gilgal bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' gu Gilgal gakdhi'ñchix gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh gu xumai gu Jerikoo.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gakdhi'ñchix koi'mɨk gu i'bhɨ gu oidha' gu takarui' cham jabka' gu tanoolh kaipgaidhat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix utu'ñ gu tanoolh buimgidhak dɨr kua'da' jugi gu i'bhɨ gu oidha'; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham pai' dhuuk chooto'n gu ñi'ook koi'mɨk gu i'bhɨ gu oidha' gu Kanaan mii' dhɨr oi'ñga'.
Jano' ba' kua' gu Josuee mia'n gu Jerikoo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui jix ñi' gu chio'ñ ka't vupui bhaan ga'ra' gu kuchii gu novɨ; gio ba' gu Josuee bhaan jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham; gu' gu Priinkipe ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Jawatan Dios jano' tɨbiap; jano' ba' gu Josuee gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu vupui gu oidha' jix duñia'; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan tu duukam.
Jano' ba' gu Priinkipe ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu Josuee; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨt; na gu' pai' jix bhaan; jano' ba' gu Josuee jix duu.
Gu' gu' gu Jerikoo ka't gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu ñi'ook kuiñcha gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' soo'mchulhdhak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' busaak.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu Josuee; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' dhagia' gu novɨ gu Jerikoo gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx gu chio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' mia'n kiicham bɨx gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham jiimchu' xikoolh kiicham jix duñia'; gio ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' kɨɨv jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv a'aa' gu chuukug vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'; gio ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh kɨɨv kiicham jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk kuichdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook vaak jodai kiicham bɨtaa'n; gio ba' jano' ba' gu ja'tkam jix tɨ'ɨ maa'n gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' tɨɨt gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan kɨɨv jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan a'aa' gu chuukug vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu Josuee ka't tu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam kɨɨv jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv a'aa' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' vupui bhaan jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' jiim.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee jix aa'ñdhix gu ja'tkam bham; gio ba' bhaan cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu chin bɨɨx ka'm gu tanoolh tu'; mi' dhɨr; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xikoolh kiicham tɨɨtɨs vaak ja'tkam chooto'n gu tukaa'.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee jix búup gu xibh jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' kɨɨv jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv a'aa' gu chuukug jix bɨɨx duu vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios jiim bɨɨx tas; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios jiim.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham gook gu tanoolh suulh vaak ja'tkam; gio ba' dhi' jix duu gu tanoolh.
Na pai' dhuuk kɨɨv gu tanoolh jix búup na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oi'ñga'n gio gu suudai' jix maa kiicham kɨɨv mui'kim; gio ba' dhi' gu tanoolh jix maa xikoolh kɨɨv mui'kim.
Ba' jix aa' na ja'p jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan a'lhiok dhaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu Josuee gu ja'tkam; na gu' gɨ' vaak ja'tkam na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhagia' kiicham.
Gu' gu' kiicham ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx bɨx tu'x; na gu' gu Raab ganai' ii'mdagaram bɨɨx bɨx gu vaak bɨɨx na gu'.
Na gu' cham gu ñi'ook kɇkɇɇda' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na gu' cham yooxi' gu Israeel.
Gu' gu' bɨx jix toja jodai jix uam jodai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai' na jix uam jix kavɨk jodai ka't jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios chumñigam gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ja'tkam jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' ka't na ja'p gu ja'tkam ka't naak jix maa gu ja'tkam bɨɨx vaak jodai; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam jix tɨ'ɨ kiicham maa'n gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx kiicham ka't; gio ba' gu chichio'ñ gu u'vɨ kɨklhi'ñga'n bɨɨx ka'm gu vaakax kakneer gu ñi'ook gu kuchii.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu Josuee gook gu chichio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha'; gio ba' ba'k gu vaak gu u'vɨ ganai' jix buus gu u'vɨ bɨx ua'tulhi'ñ na ja'p.
Jano' ba' biipibop gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baap gu Raab gu taat gu naan gu ja'tkam bɨx ka't; gio ba' gio bɨx jix dhaas mai' yooxi' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu tai kiicham bɨx ka't; gio ba' jix dhaas chumñigam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios jix toja jodai jix uam jodai gu jodai' na jix uam jix kavɨk jodai.
Gu' gu' gu Josuee gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Raab ganai' gu vaak gu taat bɨx ga'ra'; gio ba' jix daa tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Israelitas bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu Josuee bhañ gu Jerikoo.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Josuee gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bham; gio ba' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu chio'ñ dhi' kiicham gu Jerikoo; mi' dhɨr maa'nkam mar jix ali' kiki'ñgob.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu Josuee gu tɨɨgɨ' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu oidha'.

Gu' gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'; na gu' gu Akân gu mar gu Karmi gu mar gu Sabdi gu mar gu Sera bopxi'ñ gu Judaa jix bhɨɨ; mi' dhɨr daak gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu Josuee bhañ gu chichio'ñ dɨr gu Jerikoo gu ai ka't ju'ñdharan gu Bet-aben bhaan tas buusñi gu Bet-el; gio ba' tu ñi'ook bham; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha'; jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu ai.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Josuee gui'p; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ja'tkam gu' na ja'p gook jix bhai'x na ja'p vaik jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu ai; na gu' cham bɨx gu ja'tkam na gu'.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu ja'tkam na ja'p vaik jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ jiboi'ññor vupui bhaan gu ai.
Jano' ba' gu ai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ bhiadat dɨr ki'ñgob bɨɨx ka'm gu Sebarim; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu ja'tkam suudai' u'va na ja'p gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Josuee gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jajannulhi'ñ o'lhia'n gu oidha' bhaan gu vupui vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai daraa gu Israeel; gio ba' oo' bhaan ɨɨbhidham.

Ba' jix aa' gu Josuee; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu Por gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ja'tkam gu Jordaan na ba' kapbhai' gu noobh gu Amorreos gu Ojalaa jix duñia' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Israeel tu' vupui bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' gu Kananeos bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chulhiiñdha' gu tɨɨgɨ' bhaan gu oidha'; gio ba' jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duu tu' jix gɨ' gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Josuee; gio ba' bamii'; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' bhaan gu vupui.
Jano' ba' gu Israeel tu' uañi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' jix bhai'x ñi'ook na jix bhaan tu' ka't jix duñia'; na gu' jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm jix duñia' gio jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham tu jiim vupui bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ jix maat; na gu' jix duñia' tɨbiap; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook tu' cham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' bamii' jix bhaan gu ja'tkam tu'; gio ba' jix bhaan na ba' gu xibh; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu'x jai'ch tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu Israeel; gio ba' cham vupui bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx ka'm gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu xibh bopxi'ñ; gio ba' bopxi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim ja'tkam vaak; mi' dhɨr ja'tkam vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu vaak; jano' ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu chio'ñ.
Na gu' ua'tulhi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu tai bɨx juraa'n na gu' tu' jix bhai'x ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu' na cham jir bhai' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Josuee kɨkbo gu xibh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel bopxi'ñ; gio ba' ka't bopxi'ñ gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bopxi'ñ gu Judaa ka't ja'tkam vaak gu Sera; gio ba' ja'tkam vaak gu Sera gu chio'ñ ka't jix duñia' gu Sabdi.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu chio'ñ ka't jix duñia' gu Akân gu mar gu Karmi gu mar gu Sabdi gu mar gu Sera bopxi'ñ gu Judaa.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Josuee gu Akân; gio ba' gu mar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix maa gɇ'kamtu'nda' jano' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel jix duñia' bhai' ñi'ook jano' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham.
Jano' ba' gu Akân jix aa' gu Josuee bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' uañi'ñ bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu ñi'ook.
Na tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt jix bhai' jix toja jodai jix uam jodai mambhɨɨx; gio ba'; mi' dhɨr gu jodai' na jix uam bɨtaa'n gu oidha' tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaak zel tuumiñ bɨtaa'n.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee jano' ba' bhañ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bɨɨx duu jix duñia' vaak zel; gio ba' ka't gu jodai' na jix uam vaak zel tuumiñ bɨtaa'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaak zel aichdhak gu Josuee bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix dhaas vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Josuee bɨx gu Israeel bɨɨx jix bhɨɨ gu Akân gu mar gu Sera tuumiñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix uam jodai gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu vaakax gu ñi'ook kakneer vaak zel bɨx ga'ra' bhɨɨk bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Akôr.
Ba' jix aa' gu Josuee; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Tuurbete gu Jawatan Dios dhi' gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu Israelitas gu ñi'ook gu tai mi' dhɨr bɨɨx gu jodai.

Jano' ba' jix búup bhaan gɨ' kavɨk gu jodai bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook i'iich; mi' dhɨr dhi' ka't tɨɨgim mii' dhɨr pai' gu Balle gu Akôr bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Josuee; gio ba' cham jum i'obh tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ bɨndak bɨx gu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bamii' jix duñia' gu ai; jano' ba' tu' dhagia' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu ai gu ja'tkam kiicham gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ai gu gɨ'kora' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jerikoo gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu vaakax gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim na ba' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr kiicham.
Jano' ba' jix búup gu Josuee bɨx gu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham na ba' jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan gu ai; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Josuee gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk bhañ gu tukaa'.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham; mi' dhɨr cham jix jai' kiicham dhi' bɨx.
Jano' ba' tu' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham; na pai' dhuuk bhaan no'ch na ja'p jix duu va'k vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan no'ch bɨɨx ka'm kiicham; na gu'; mi' dhɨr no'ch na ja'p jix duñia'; jano' ba' vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan kiicham; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios kapbhai' gu noobh.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu tai; gio ba' jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Josuee bhañ; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix dhaas tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Bet-el gu ai tas gei'ñ gu ai; mi' dhɨr gu Josuee mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' kɨkbo gu Josuee gu bhóogɨt gu xibh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam jix tɨ'ɨ bɨɨx daraa gu Israeel vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam bhaan gu ai.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx ka't jix tɨ'ɨ gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan kiicham yooxi' baasɨ'n gu ñi'ook gu ai; gio ba' ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ai.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ na ja'p jixchamaam jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Bet-el gu ai baasɨ'n kiicham.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam bɨx yooxi' ka't baasɨ'n gu ñi'ook kiicham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' mia'n tas gei'ñ kiicham suudai' u'va gu Josuee mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu ai jix búup gu xibh jix buus bɨɨx gu ja'tkam kiicham bhaan gu Israeel bɨx gu ja'tkam na ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook nɨi'ñchudat cham pu'ñir ka't jix duñia' kiicham.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Josuee bɨx gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jiboi'ññor vupui bhaan gu bhóogɨt oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't gu ai jum daa'ñ na ba' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bhiadat gu Josuee gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham.
Jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu ai gu Bet-el cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Israeel; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu ñi'ook kiicham jix kupi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Josuee; na gu' gu ñi'ook u'u kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ bhaan gu ai na gu' tu' kapbhai' gu novɨ; mi' dhɨr gu Josuee jix búup bhaan kiicham u'u kavɨk gu novɨ ga'ra'.
Jano' ba' kɨkbo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai' mi'p jix duñia' gu novɨ tɨɨtɨs kiicham gu ñi'ook buuplhia' gu tai.
Jano' ba' na ja'p kiicham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuubh kiicham gu tɨkɨr cham chooto'n na ba' tu' baasɨ'n tu'; gio ba' gu ja'tkam bhaan oidha' jix gaki bhaan oi'ñchu'.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee bɨx gu Israeel ñɨi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' kiicham kuubh kiicham tu' gu ai.
Jano' ba' moor kiicham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Israeel baasɨ'n; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx ka'm cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu ai aichdhak gu Josuee.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Israelitas jix bɨɨx duu kooda' bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu ai yooxi' oidha' jix gaki pai' jix daa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx jix daa gu kuchii bɨɨx ka'm bɨx gu Israelitas gu ai gio jix dhaas.
Jano' ba' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' ia'rɨ mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu chichio'ñ gu u'vɨ ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x bɨx gu ai.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ ka't bɨɨx u'u kavɨk bɨɨx ka'm ka't bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu ai.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu Israelitas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu vaakax kiicham jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' gu Josuee.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee gu ñi'ook gu ai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɨ' kavɨk gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.

Gu' gu' gu gɨ'kora' gu ai jix duñia' jix duu bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai; gio ba' na ja'p gu tas jix dhaas jix aa'ñdhix gu Josuee gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duu gu chuukug jix duñia' ki'ñgob kiicham; mi' dhɨr jix búup bhaan gɨ' kavɨk gu jodai bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu jano' ba' gu Josuee jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu kavɨk gu Ebal.

Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na ja'p ua'nak u'uan ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Moisees jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu jodai jix duñia' bhaan soo'mchulhdhak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kavɨk jodai; gio ba' bhaan maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' gio ua'na gu jodai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Moisees ka't ua'nak vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu Israeel daraa gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mi'p baasɨ'n ju'ñdharan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' vupui bhaan jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas gu ux na tu ibai' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook na ja'p tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't bhaan gu kavɨk gu Gerisim tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu kavɨk gu Ebal; mi' dhɨr gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' va'k na ba' ua'tulhi'ñdha' gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga bɨx gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jurtu'nka' bɨx ua'nak u'uan ñi'ook na tu a'ga.
Jano' ba' cham ka't gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx tu'x jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees gu Josuee cham vupui bhaan bɨx gu Israeel gu u'vɨ a'aalh gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' tu'x bɨx gu gɨ'kora' mi'p dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan gɨ' kavɨk na ja'p bɨx gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ' suudai' vupui bhaan gu Liibano gu eteos gu Amorreos gu Kananeos gu Pereseos gu ebeos gu Jebuseos.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' bhaan gu Josuee tu' gu Israeel.
Gu' gu' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Gabaoon na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Josuee ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jerikoo gu ai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio; na gu' jix bɨɨx duu jix bhɨɨ kɨklhi'ñga'n bhaan gu ñi'ook o'jo' kɨklhi'ñga'n suudai' u'va.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨklhi'ñga'n tɨɨt bɨɨx jajannulhi'ñ kɨklhi'ñga'n bhaan; gio ba' bɨx gu takarui' na ba' gu bhóogɨt jix gaki.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Josuee yooxi' gu Gilgal gui'p gu Israeel; gio ba' no'ch gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr jano' bɨɨx no'ch ñi'ook na jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu Israeel tu ñi'ook gu ebeos; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook no'ch bhaan ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Josuee; gio ba' no'ch gu'ch tu duukam; mi' dhɨr gu Josuee jix aa'; jano' ba' chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duukat.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu duukam jix duñia' tɨbiap gu bhóogɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' naak gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n bɨx tu'x jix duu gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jix duu bɨx gook gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos mi'p baasɨ'n gu Jordaan; gio ba' gu Seoon gu gɨ'kora' gu esboon gu Og gu gɨ'kora' gu Basaan ka't gu Astarot.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x daraa bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu oidha' gui'p; gio ba' gu noobh na ba' gu bhóogɨt tu' ja'xñi; mi' dhɨr no'ch gu'ch tu duukam jano' bɨɨx no'ch ñi'ook na jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' dhi' chulhiiñdha' gu takarui' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix tónom gu takarui' gu vaak na ba' gu bhóogɨt gu tanoolh na ba'; gio ba' jano' jix gaki.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam o'jo' suudai' u'va gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xixiibkam; gio ba' tu'; mi' dhɨr gio dhi' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook jajannulhi'ñ gu ñi'ook tu' kɨklhi'ñga'n kuiñcha gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel jix bhɨɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt cham tɨkka gu chin gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Josuee bhai'x i'ii'ñ bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu oidha'; gio ba' gio chiñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaik gu tanoolh mi' dhɨr jix duu bɨɨx na ja'p jix duñia' oi'ñka' tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel vaik gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨ'dɨlh; gio ba' jɨ'dɨlh jix duñia' gu Gabaoon gu Kapira gu Beerot gu Kiriat-jearim.
Na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na gu' chiñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook vaak jodai bhaan chiñia'.
Gu' gu' bɨx chiñia' tu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' no'ch gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; na ba' jano' cham kuichdha'.
Jano' ba' dhi' chulhiiñchuda' bɨɨx; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duaka' na gu' cham daak bhaan no'ch kuiñcha gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' chiñia' gui'p; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gu' ka't gu oi'ñga'n gio gu suudai' na ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook na ja'p chiñia' jix duñia' tu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Josuee bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bham gu abitamos gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu ñi'ook tu duukam gu ñi'ook gu u'u gu suudai' na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Josuee gui'p; gio ba' na ja'p ka't jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' gu Moisees tu duukam ka't bɨx gu oidha' ka't cham tu' duu bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu oidha' vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ tu' dhi'.
Jano' ba' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ; gio ba' tu' jix bhai' gu ñi'ook duñia' no'ch tu jiim.
Jano' ba' jix duu; na jix duñia' gu novɨ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Josuee mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu oi'ñga'n gio gu suudai' na ba' gu ñi'ook na ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios pai'; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix duu na ja'p gu Adonisedek gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem jix kai gu Josuee ka't jix duñia' gu ai ka't gu ñi'ook na ja'p ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jerikoo gu gɨ'kora' gu ai gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Gabaoon jix daa gu ñi'ook bhai'x i'ii'ñ bɨɨx gu Israelitas mi'p tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' chooto'n gu bhóogɨt choo'n; na gu' gu Gabaoon ka't kiicham na ja'p jɨ'dɨlh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix gɨ' gu ai bɨx gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu ñi'ook gu Adonisedek gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem gu Oam gu gɨ'kora' gu ebroon gu Piream gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerimot gu Japia gu gɨ'kora' gu Lakîs gu Debir gu gɨ'kora' gu Egloon.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Gabaoon; na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook bhai'x i'ii'ñ bɨɨx gu Josuee bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jixchamaam gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem gu gɨ'kora' gu ebroon gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerimot gu gɨ'kora' gu Lakîs gu gɨ'kora' gu Egloon jum daa'ñ jix tɨ'ɨ bɨɨx bɨx chugi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' bhaan gu Gabaoon bhaan.

Jano' ba' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Gabaoon mɨjɨ a'ga gu Josuee yooxi' gu Gilgal; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu noobh tu duukam; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' no'ch na ba'; na gu' bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos gɨ' kavɨk jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bhaan no'ch.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Josuee gu Gilgal bɨx gu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx bɨx gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Josuee; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam choo'n; na gu' tu' dhagia' gu novɨ gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee suudai' u'va jix bhai'x bɨx gu tukaa' jix tɨ'ɨ dɨr gu Gilgal.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Israeel tu' naaka'n bɨɨx gu Gabaoon; gio ba' chɨ'ɨɨk gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu Bet-oron tu' naaka'n bɨɨx ka'm gu Aseka gu Makeda.

Jano' ba' na ja'p jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israelitas gu Bet-oron gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' bhaan gu tɨkɨr gu jodai bɨɨx ka'm gu Aseka jix koko'; gio ba' mui'x jix koko' gu jodai gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix koi.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Josuee gu Jawatan Dios gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gu Amorreo vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israelitas; gio ba' gu tas gu Gabaoon; mi' dhɨr tu' gu masad gu ñi'ook gu Ajaloon.
Jano' ba' gu tas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu masad bɨɨx ka'm gu ja'tkam ka't obhɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' cham ua'nak u'uan gu Jaser gu tas gu masad tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tɨkɨr cham jix duñia' gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' cham pai' dhuuk ka't jix duñia' gu tanoolh va'k tu' mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhaibu gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee bɨx gu Israeel bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' gu Gilgal.
Gu' gu' jixchamaam gu gɨ'kora' jiboi'ññor gu ñi'ook jumpa'n gu Makeda.
Jano' ba' ka't tu ñi'ook gu Josuee jixchamaam gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bakia' jumpa'n gu Makeda.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Josuee; gio ba' gu Rodad gu jodai gu chin jumpa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ ju'ñdharan jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu ñi'ook obhɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gio gu suudai' cham jix duñia' baakɨi jɨ'dɨlh; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhagia' gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p gu Josuee gu ma'nkam gu Israeel a'lhiok gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt jix gɨ' bɨɨx ka'm cham tu' duu jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' yooxi' gu Josuee gu Makeda; na cham ka't nɨɨn bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Josuee; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chin jumpa'n jix buusñi dhi' ja'tkam jixchamaam gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jumpa'n mii' dhɨr ja'tkam jixchamaam gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem gu gɨ'kora' gu ebroon gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerimot gu gɨ'kora' gu Lakîs gu gɨ'kora' gu Egloon.

Ba' jix aa' na pai' dhuuk a'lhiok jix buusñi dhi' ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora' gu Josuee jup tɨɨt gu Josuee bɨx gu chio'ñ gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨbiap bɨɨx; gio ba' tɨɨt bhaan gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr jix dhaas tɨɨt bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' gu Josuee; gio ba' cham ɨɨbhi'ñdha' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix duu mi' dhɨr dhi' gu Josuee naaka'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' jixchamaam; gio ba' jix duu bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix dhaas jix aa'ñdhix gu Josuee jix duu jix duñia' jumpa'n pai' gu jodai' na jix uam; gio ba' jix dhaas gu jodai gu chin jumpa'n bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jix bhɨɨ gu Josuee gu Makeda jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' bɨx ga'ra' gu oidha' cham gu ñi'ook cham tu'; gu' gu gɨ'kora' gu Makeda jix duu na ja'p ka't gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerikoo.
Jano' ba' gu Makeda gu ñi'ook gu Josuee bɨx gu Israeel bɨɨx gu Libna; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Libna.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gio gu gɨ'kora' gu noobh gu Israeel; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kuchii bɨɨx bɨx ka't gu ñi'ook cham gu ñi'ook cham tu'; gu' gu gɨ'kora' jix duu ka't gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerikoo.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee bɨx gu Israeel bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu Libna gu Lakîs jix dhaas yooxi' bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gu Lakîs gu novɨ gu Israeel jix bhɨɨ gu tanoolh buimgidhak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx bɨx ka't gu ñi'ook na ja'p ka't gu ñi'ook gu Libna.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu oram gu gɨ'kora' gu Geser jix tɨ'ɨ u'ua'tɨdham gu Lakîs; gu' gu ja'tkam naaka'n gu Josuee bɨɨx ka'm cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu Lakîs gu ñi'ook gu Josuee bɨx gu Israeel bɨɨx gu Egloon; gio ba' jix dhaas yooxi' bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh bɨx ka't gu ñi'ook na ja'p ka't gu ñi'ook gu Lakîs.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Josuee bɨx gu Israeel bɨɨx gu Egloon gu ebroon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' bɨx jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx bɨx ka't gu ñi'ook cham gu ñi'ook cham tu'; gio ba' na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu Egloon bɨɨx bɨx ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gɨɨsɨk gu Josuee bɨx gu Israeel bɨɨx bhaan gu Debir gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook cham gu ñi'ook cham tu'; mi' dhɨr na ja'p ka't gu ñi'ook gu ebroon jix duu gu Debir gu gɨ'kora'; jano' ba' na ja'p ka't gu ñi'ook gu Libna gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' naaka'n gu Josuee bɨx gu ñi'ook gɨ' kavɨk saagi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu gɨ'kora' cham gu ñi'ook cham tu'; gio ba' bɨx ga'ra' gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel ka't jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' naaka'n gu Josuee dɨr gu Kades-barnea bɨɨx ka'm gu Gasa bɨx gu oidha' gu Goseen bɨɨx ka'm gu Gabaoon.
Jano' ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora' oi'ñga'n jix bhɨɨ gu Josuee jix duñia'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Josuee bɨx gu Israeel bɨɨx yooxi' gu Gilgal.
Jano' ba' tɨiñ dhi' gu Jabiin gu gɨ'kora' gu asor bhañ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jobab gu gɨ'kora' gu Madoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Simrom gu gɨ'kora' gu Aksap.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' mi'p baasɨ'n gu ñi'ook gɨ' kavɨk jix duñia' saagi'ñ gu Kinnerot gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dor tas gei'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Kananeo ka't tas buusñi tas gei'ñ gu Amorreo gu eteo gu Pereseo gu Jebuseo gɨ' kavɨk gu ebeo bɨtaa'n gu ermoon gu oidha' gu Mispa.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam moor bɨɨx bɨx chugi'ñ gu ja'tkam jix jai' na ja'p oo' jugii'ñ gu gɨ' suudai' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kavaayo.
Jano' ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora' jum daa'ñ bai'ñpu' jum daa'ñ vaak ja'tkam ju'ñdharan gu suudai' gu Merom na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Israeel.

Ba' jix aa' gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu Josuee; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam choo'n gu xibh dhi' gu tas tu' kapbhai' bɨx suulhgia' koko'kam vupui bhaan gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr kavaayo gu ñi'ook gu tai.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Josuee bɨɨx bɨx gu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan jix maa jix bhai'x bhaan ju'ñdharan gu suudai' gu Merom.
Jano' ba' do'ñcho gu Jawatan Dios gu noobh gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhiadat bɨɨx ka'm gu Sidoon jix gɨ' bɨɨx ka'm gu suudai' bɨɨx ka'm jix duñia' gu Mispa tas buusñi bɨɨx ka'm cham.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Josuee bɨɨx na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kavaayo gu ñi'ook gu tai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Josuee jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook gu asor tu' naaka'n gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu asor ka't jix duñia' va'k mo'o bɨx dhi' ja'tkam oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx ka't gu ñi'ook jix duñia' cham bɨɨx gu oidha'; gio ba' gu Asor jix dhaas gu tai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhɨɨ gu Josuee bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu gɨ'kora' na ja'p gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia'.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook bɨx jɨ'dɨlh mi'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu Asor gu ñi'ook gu Josuee.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' bɨx gu vaakax jɨ'dɨlh; gu' bɨx gu chichio'ñ bɨɨx ka'm cham tu' duu cham oi'ñdha' bɨɨx gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' gu Moisees tu duukam gu Moisees jix aa'ñdhix gu Josuee; gio ba' gu Josuee jix duu cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨx gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Josuee bɨx mii' dhɨr gu oidha' gɨ' kavɨk bɨx gu ñi'ook saagi'ñ bɨx gu oidha' gu Goseen gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' dɨr gu kavɨk gu alak jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm gu Seir bɨɨx ka'm gu Baal-gad gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Liibano gu kavɨk gu ermoon; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ bɨx gu gɨ'kora' naaka'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mui'x gu tanoolh jix duñia' bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Josuee bɨɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' cham ka't kiicham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhai'x i'ii'ñ bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix buusñi gu ebeos gu Gabaoon; gio ba' bɨx jix bhɨɨ bhɨɨ'ñdham.

Na gu' na gu' dhi' suudai' u'va gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ na ba' bɨɨx bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Israeel na ba' cham tu' duu cham jum duu xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch va'k bhaai'n na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' gu Moisees.

Jano' ba' gio gu ñi'ook suudai' u'va gu Josuee gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Anakeos gu kakkavɨk gu ebroon gu Debir gu Anab bɨx gu kakkavɨk gu Judaa bɨx gu kakkavɨk gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Josuee jɨ'dɨlh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Anakeos gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Gasa gu Gat gu Asdod.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Josuee bɨx gu oidha' jurtu'nka' bɨx gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu Moisees; gio ba' do'ñcho gu Josuee gu Israelitas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jurtu'nka' bopxi'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu oidha' jix utu'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora' gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan gu tas dɨr jix duu gu Arnoon bɨɨx ka'm gu kavɨk gu ermoon bɨx gu ux na tu ibai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos jix daa gu esboon aapi' dɨr gu Aroer jix duu gu Arnoon dɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Galaad bɨɨx ka'm gu Jabok gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.

Jano' ba' dɨr vaak ja'tkam bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ' suudai' gu Kinnerot tas buusñi; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ' suudai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ' suudai' gu Salado tas buusñi gu bhóogɨt gu Bet-jesimot; mi' dhɨr dɨr saagi'ñ bɨtaa'n gu Pisga.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Og gu gɨ'kora' gu Basaan ka't jix duñia' gu Rapeos jix daa gu Astarot gu Edrei.
Jano' ba' aapi' gu kavɨk gu ermoon gu Salka bɨx gu Basaan bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu Gessuri gu Maakâti tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Galaad gu ñi'ook gu Seoon gu gɨ'kora' gu esboon.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios jix maa mii' dhɨr gu oidha' gu maa'nkar gu Rubenitas gu Gaditas ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora' gu oidha' naaka'n gu Josuee bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan tas gei'ñ dɨr gu Baal-gad jix duñia' gu Liibano bɨɨx ka'm gu kavɨk gu alak jix duñia' gu Seir; gio ba' gu oidha' jix maa gu Josuee gu maa'nkar bopxi'ñ gu Israeel jurtu'nka' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu kakkavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' jix gaki saagi'ñ; gio ba' gu eteo gu Amorreo gu Kananeo gu Pereseo gu ebeo gu Jebuseo.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerikoo maa'n; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu ai gu ñi'ook gu Bet-el.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu ebroon.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jarmut; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Lakîs.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Egloon; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Geser.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Debir; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Geder.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu orma; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Arad.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Libna; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Adullam.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Makeda; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Bet-el.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Tappua; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu eper.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Apek; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Lasaroon.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Madoon; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu asor.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Simrom-meron; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Aksap.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Taanak; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Megiddo.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Kêdes; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jokneam gu Karmel.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dor oidha' gɨ' gu Dor; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Gentes gu Gilgal.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Tirsa; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' bɨx.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Josuee tu' jix duñia' kia'mi'ñ gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu oidha' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu oidha' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Pilisteos bɨx gu Gessuri.

Jano' ba' dɨr gu Sior vupui bhaan gu Ejipto bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu Akkaroon gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Kananeos; gio ba' jixchamaam oidha' gɨ' gu Pilisteos; mi' dhɨr gu Gaseos gu Asdodios gu Askalonitas gu Geteos gu Akkaronitas; jano' ba' gu ebeos.
Jano' ba' saagi'ñ bɨx gu oidha' gu Kananeos gu Meara gu Sidonios bɨɨx ka'm gu Apek bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu Amorreo.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' gu Gibleos bɨx gu Liibano bhaan pai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tas dɨr gu Baal-gad gu kavɨk gu ermoon bɨɨx ka'm baakɨi gu amat.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɨ' kavɨk dɨr gu Liibano bɨɨx ka'm gu suudai' bɨx gu Sidonios; gio ba' tu' vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Israelitas gu maa'nkar na ja'p tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' baasɨ'n tu' jano' dhi' gu oidha' gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook bopxi'ñ ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees.
Na gu' na gu' ɨraab gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar bɨɨx gu Rubenitas gu Gaditas jix maa gu Moisees baasɨ'n gu Jordaan tas buusñi bhaan jix maa gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' dɨr gu Aroer jugii'ñ jix duu gu Arnoon kiicham tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx vaak ja'tkam gu Medeba bɨɨx ka'm gu Diboon.
Jano' ba' bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu Seoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos jix gɨ'kora' gu esboon bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.
Jano' ba' gu Galaad gu ñi'ook gu Gessuri gu Maakâti bɨx gu kavɨk gu ermoon bɨx gu oidha' gu Basaan bɨɨx ka'm gu Salkâ.
Jano' ba' bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Og gu Basaan jix gɨ'kora' gu Astarot gu Edrei ka't jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Rapeos; na gu' gu Moisees naaka'n.
Gu' gu' gu Gessuri gu Maakâti cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' va'k gu Gessur gu Maakât jix daa tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Israelitas bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook bopxi'ñ gu Lebii cham jix maa gu maa'nkar; gio ba' makgɨrxi'ñdha' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu maa'nkar na ja'p ka't tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu Moisees bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen jurtu'nka' ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook dɨr gu Aroer jugii'ñ jix duu gu Arnoon kiicham tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx vaak ja'tkam bɨɨx ka'm gu Medeba.
Jano' ba' gu esboon bɨɨx bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Diboon gu Bamot-baal gu Bet-baal-meoon.
Jano' ba' gu Jaas gu Keddemot gu Mepaat.
Jano' ba' gu Kîriataim gu Sibma gu Seretsaar gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Bet-peor gu Asdot-pisga gu Bet-jesimot.

Jano' ba' bɨx jɨ'dɨlh vaak ja'tkam bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Seoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos jix gɨ'kora' gu esboon naaka'n gu Moisees chiñia' gu Madiaan gu ebi gu Rekem gu Sur gu ur gu Reba chiñia' gu Seoon oi'ñka' mii' dhɨr gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gio mu'aa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Balaam gu mar gu Beor bɨɨx mu'aa.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen gu Jordaan bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' dhi' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen jurtu'nka' ja'tkam vaak dhi' jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moisees bopxi'ñ gu Gad gu ma'nkam gu Gad jurtu'nka' ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu Jaker bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu Galaad tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon bɨɨx ka'm gu Aroer vupui bhaan gu Rabba.
Jano' ba' dɨr gu esboon bɨɨx ka'm gu Ramatmispe gu Betonim; gio ba' dɨr gu Maanaim bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu Debir.

Jano' ba' vaak ja'tkam gu Bet-aram gu Bet-nimra gu Sukot gu Sapoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Seoon gu gɨ'kora' gu esboon; gio ba' gu Jordaan gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ' suudai' gu Kinneret baasɨ'n gu Jordaan tas buusñi.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Gad ja'tkam vaak dhi' jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gio jix maa gu Moisees gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees; gio ba' ka't ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Manasees jurtu'nka' ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka't dɨr gu Maanaim bɨx gu Basaan bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Og gu gɨ'kora' gu Basaan bɨx taañpu' gu Jair gu Basaan gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.

Jano' ba' jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Galaad gu Astarot gu Edrei jɨ'dɨlh oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Og gu Basaan gu ma'nkam gu Makîr gu mar gu Manasees tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Makîr jurtu'nka' ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu Moisees gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar gu Moab baasɨ'n gu Jordaan gu Jerikoo tas buusñi.
Gu' gu' bopxi'ñ gu Lebii cham jix maa gu Moisees gu maa'nkar; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu maa'nkar na ja'p ka't tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' dhi' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar gu oidha' gu Kanaan gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun gu ñi'ook tattat bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' gu Moisees koi gu ñi'ook bopxi'ñ ɨraab bopxi'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' gook bopxi'ñ ɨraab bopxi'ñ ka't gu Moisees jix maa gu maa'nkar baasɨ'n gu Jordaan; gu' gu Lebitas cham jix maa gu maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' gu ma'nkam gu Josee jix bɨɨx duu gook bopxi'ñ gu Manasees gu Epraim; gio ba' cham jix maa baasɨ'n gu Lebitas gu oidha' gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' gu Moisees jix duu gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Judaa tɨɨtɨs gu Josuee gu Gilgal; gio ba' gu Kaleb gu mar gu Jepone gu Keneseo jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' ñɨidhat gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu Moisees gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Kades-barnea gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'.
Na pai' dhuuk tu' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oo'm na pai' dhuuk gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios bhañ gu Kades-barnea gu oidha'; gio ba' tu' na ja'p ga'ra' gu i'ii'ñ.
Gu' gu' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ gu ja'tkam; gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Moisees gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' tu' gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨt cham ua'tulhi'ñ na ba' tu' na ba' gu ma'nkam; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jano' xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook duaka' na ja'p dhi' ja'tkam oo'm jixchamaam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Moisees na pai' dhuuk gu Israeel jiim oidha' jix gaki; gio ba' jano' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh jix bhai'x jixchamaam.

Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk na ja'p gu tanoolh gu Moisees bhañ; gio ba' ka't jano' ba' gu kavɨk jix duñia' jano' na ba' bhɨɨ'ñdham na ba' jix buus na ba' baakɨi.

Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' dhi' gu kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh; na gu' tu' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Anakeos jix kavɨk jɨ'dɨlh; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios ka't na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Josuee jano' ba' jix bhai' aa' jix maa gu Kaleb gu mar gu Jepone gu ebroon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar.
Na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ebroon ka't gu Kaleb gu mar gu Jepone gu Keneseo gu maa'nkar bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Gu' gu' gu ebroon ka't va'k mɨmɨim gu Kîriat-arba; gio ba' ka't gu Arba gu chio'ñ jix gɨ' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Anakeos; mi' dhɨr gu oidha' jix duñia' jɨɨpi'ñka' bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Judaa ja'tkam vaak ju'ñdharan gu ñi'ook gu Edom oidha' jix gaki gu Sin saagi'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n saagi'ñ ka't dɨr gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ' suudai' gu Salado dɨr nɨɨn gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan saagi'ñ.
Jano' ba' busaak bhaan saagi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Akrabim bhɨi bɨɨx ka'm gu Sin; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ saagi'ñ bɨɨx ka'm gu Kades-barnea gu ñi'ook gu ebroon jix tɨ'ɨ gu Addar gu Karka.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Asmoon busaak jix duu gu Ejipto; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu ñi'ook tas gei'ñ; mi' dhɨr dhi' ka't gu ñi'ook saagi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tas buusñi gu gɨ' suudai' gu Salado bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan; gio ba' gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n gu ñi'ook dɨr nɨɨn gu gɨ' suudai' dɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Bet-ogla gu ñi'ook gu Bet-araba jix duñia' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu jodai gu Boaan gu mar gu Rubeen.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix tɨ'ɨ dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Debir dɨr gu ñi'ook gu Akôr; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Gilgal vupui bhaan gu Adumin saagi'ñ jix duu; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu En-semes suudai' buusñi gu Rogel.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu mar gu innom gu ñi'ook gu Jebuseo saagi'ñ; gio ba' dhi' gu Jerusalem; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook gu innom bhaan tas gei'ñ gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ dhi' gu ñi'ook dɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk bɨɨx ka'm suudai' buusñi gu suudai' gu Neptoa jɨ'dɨlh gu kavɨk gu Eproon gu ñi'ook gu Baala gu Kîriat-jearim.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu ñi'ook dɨr gu Baala bhaan tas gei'ñ gu kavɨk gu Seir; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk gu Jearim bhaan gu ñi'ook dhi' gu Kesaloon gu Bet-semes gu ñi'ook gu Timna.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Ekroon bhaan gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Sikêron gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk gu Baala gu Jabneel; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ' suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tas gei'ñ gu gɨ' suudai' jix gɨ'; gio ba' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Judaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam vaak.
Gu' gu' gu Kaleb gu mar gu Jepone jix maa baasɨ'n tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Judaa jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Josuee; gio ba' dhi' gu Kîriat-arba gu taat gu Anak gu ebroon.
Jano' ba' gu Kaleb gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaik gu ma'nkam gu Anak gu Sesai gu Aiman gu Talmai gu ma'nkam gu Anak.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Debir; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Debir ka't va'k gu Kîriat-seper.
Ba' jix aa' gu Kaleb; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Kîriat-seper gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mar u'vɨ gu Axa gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Otoniel gu mar gu Kenes xibhɨk gu Kaleb; gio ba' jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ mar u'vɨ gu Axa.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu taat na ba'; gio ba' jano' ba' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Kaleb jix aa'; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; na gu' jix maa gu oidha' gio suudai' buusñi gu suudai'; jano' ba' jix maa suudai' buusñi jiix.
