Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook dɨr gu elep gu Alloon-saananim gu Adami-nekeb gu Jabneel bɨɨx ka'm gu Lakum; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jordaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu ñi'ook bhaan tas gei'ñ gu Asnot-tabor gu ukuka bɨɨx ka'm gu Sabuloon saagi'ñ tas gei'ñ bɨɨx gu Aser bɨɨx gu Judaa gu Jordaan bhaan pai' gu tas.
Jano' ba' jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk gu Siddim gu Ser gu amat gu Rakkat gu Kinnerot.
Jano' ba' gu Adama gu Rama gu Asor.
Jano' ba' gu Kedes gu Edrei gu En-asor.
Jano' ba' gu Iroon gu Migdalel gu orem gu Bet-anat gu Bet-semes; gio ba' mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu maa'nkar bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Neptalii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' dhi' jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix buus bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Dan ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu Sora gu Estaol tu' gu Ir-semes.
Jano' ba' gu Saalabiin gu Ailoon gu Jet-la.
Jano' ba' gu Eloon gu Timnata gu Ekroon.
Jano' ba' gu Eltekê gu Gibbetoon gu Baalat.
Jano' ba' gu Jeud gu Bene-beraak gu Gat-rimmoon.
Jano' ba' gu Mejarkoon gu Rakkoon bɨɨx gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Joppa.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Dan; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu ma'nkam gu Dan gu Lesem gu kuchii jix daa; mi' dhɨr tɨɨt gu Lesem gu Dan gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Dan gu taat.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu maa'nkar bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Dan jurtu'nka' ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' dhi' jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu maa'nkar jix maa gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu maa'nkar gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix maa kiicham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Timnat-sera gu kavɨk gu Epraim; gio ba' kiicham jix daa.

Jano' ba' dhi' dɨppɨr gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun gu ñi'ook tattat kapbhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Silo vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios ba'k vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Josuee bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bham; gio ba' nɨi'ñchudat jɨ'dɨlh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Moisees.
Na ba' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mua'kam kooda' oi'ñdha' cham; na ka't mia'n jix koi.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr jɨ'dɨlh ki'ñgob kiicham daraa mii' dhɨr kiicham; gio ba' baidhak gu ñi'ook kiicham pai' jix duñia' bɨɨx.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk mia'n jix koi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham kapbhai' gu novɨ mua'kam na gu' naaka'n tɨtmo gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' bɨɨx va'k.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr kiicham bɨɨx ka'm ñi'ook na jir bhai' vupui bhaan bɨɨx ka'm koi'm jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ua'tulhi'ñ mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jano' ba' mua'kam ɨlhdham kiicham gu vaak kiicham pai'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' nɨi'ñchudat gu Kedes gu Galilea gu kavɨk gu Neptalii gu Sikêm gu kavɨk gu Epraim gu Kîriat-arba gu ebroon gu kavɨk gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan gu Jerikoo tas buusñi nɨi'ñchudat gu Beser oidha' jix gaki gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bopxi'ñ gu Rubeen gu Ramot gu Galaad bopxi'ñ gu Gad gu Gauloon gu Basaan bopxi'ñ gu Manasees.

Jano' ba' dhi' jix bɨɨx duu jɨ'dɨlh nɨi'ñchudat na ba' bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na ba' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam no'x gu chio'ñ cham vaak jodai gu novɨ mia'n jix koi bɨɨx ka'm vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tattat gu Lebitas tɨɨtɨs gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun gu ñi'ook tattat bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Silo gu oidha' gu Kanaan bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moisees bhaai'n gɨ' vaak ja'tkam na ba' jix daa bɨɨx na ba' gu vaakax.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix maa gu Lebitas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios dhi' bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' jix buus gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam vaak gu Koatitas; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu gɨ' vaak ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' gu Lebitas bopxi'ñ gu Judaa gu Simeoon gu Benjamiin.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Koat jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mambhɨɨx ja'tkam vaak bopxi'ñ gu Epraim bopxi'ñ gu Dan ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Gersoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam vaak bopxi'ñ gu Issakâr bopxi'ñ gu Aser bopxi'ñ gu Neptalii ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees gu Basaan jix bɨɨx duu gɨ' vaak ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Merari gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam vaak jix maa bopxi'ñ gu Rubeen bopxi'ñ gu Gad bopxi'ñ gu Sabuloon.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Lebitas dhi' bɨɨx na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Judaa bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Simeoon jix maa dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bɨɨx duu.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon ja'tkam vaak gu Koat gu ma'nkam gu Lebii.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu Kîriat-arba gu taat gu Anak gu ebroon gu kavɨk gu Judaa bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Gu' gu' yooxi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham taañpu' jix maa gu Kaleb gu mar gu Jepone gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix maa kiicham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu ebroon bɨɨx; gio ba' gu Libna bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu Jattir bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Extemoo bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu eloon bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Debir bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu Ain bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jutta bɨɨx gu Bet-semes bɨɨx; gio ba' gu ñi'ook dhi' gook bopxi'ñ.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Benjamiin gu Gibeoon bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Geba bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu Anatot bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Almoon bɨɨx; gio ba' maakobh.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon bɨɨx.
Gu' gu' ja'tkam vaak gu ma'nkam gu Koat gu Lebitas gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Koat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bopxi'ñ gu Epraim.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu Sikêm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' bɨɨx gu kavɨk gu Epraim; gio ba' gu Geser bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu Kibsaim bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Bet-oron bɨɨx; gio ba' maakobh.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Dan gu Elteko bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Gibetoon bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu Ayaloon bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Gat-rimmoon bɨɨx; gio ba' maakobh.
Jano' ba' ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees gu Taanak bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Gat-rimmoon bɨɨx; gio ba' gook.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' ja'tkam vaak gu ma'nkam gu Koat jix bɨɨx duu mambhɨɨx bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Gersoon ja'tkam vaak gu Lebitas jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees; gio ba' gu Gauloon gu Basaan bɨɨx gu Bosra bɨɨx; mi' dhɨr gook.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Issakâr gu Kesioon bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Daberet bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu Jarmut bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu En-gannim bɨɨx; gio ba' maakobh.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Aser gu Miseal bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Abdoon bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu elkât bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Reob bɨɨx; gio ba' maakobh.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Neptalii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu Kedes gu Galilea bɨɨx gu ammot-dor bɨɨx gu Kartaan bɨɨx; gio ba' vaik.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Gersonitas ja'tkam vaak jix bɨɨx duu bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' ja'tkam vaak gu ma'nkam gu Merari gu Lebitas gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bopxi'ñ gu Sabuloon gu Jokneam bɨɨx gu Karta bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu Dimna bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Naalal bɨɨx; gio ba' maakobh.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Rubeen gu Beser bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jasa bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu Kedemot bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Mepaat bɨɨx; gio ba' maakobh.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Gad gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu Ramot gu Galaad bɨɨx gu Maanaim bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu esboon bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jaker bɨɨx; gio ba' maakobh.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Merari ja'tkam vaak gu Lebitas jix bɨɨx duu mamai'chɨk.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Lebitas tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu maa'nkar gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix bɨɨx duu oo'm bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' dhi' jɨ'dɨlh mi'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx xikoolh; gio ba' ka't bɨx dhi' jɨ'dɨlh.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel bɨx gu oidha' ka't gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tattat; gio ba' jix daa.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa jɨɨpi'ñka' xikoolh jurtu'nka' bɨx ka't gu ñi'ook tattat; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gu noobh bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨx jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu Israeel; gio ba' bɨx.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Josuee jup tɨɨt gu Rubenitas gu Gaditas ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bɨx gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨx jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu ja'tkam dhi' ja'tkam mui'x gu tanoolh bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook va'k jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jano' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa jɨɨpi'ñka' gu ja'tkam na ja'p ka't jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak zel gu oidha' gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios jix maa baasɨ'n gu Jordaan.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook tu duukam gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios; na kai'chɨt gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu bhóogɨt; na gu ñi'ook bɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Josuee bhañ; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu vaak zel.

Jano' ba' gio ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees ka't jix maa gu Moisees gu maa'nkar gu Basaan; gu' ɨraab jix maa gu Josuee gu maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan tas gei'ñ; mi' dhɨr gio suulhgia' bhañ gu Josuee vaak zel mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.

Ba' jix aa' bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook vaak zel bɨɨx namkɨm bɨɨx jix gɨ' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax bɨɨx jix toja jodai bɨɨx jix uam jodai gu jodai' na jix uam mui'x jajannulhi'ñ; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx gu ja'tkam obhɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen gu ma'nkam gu Gad ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Silo gu oidha' gu Kanaan na ba' tu' gu oidha' gu Galaad pai' jix duñia' bia'ka' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ gu Moisees.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jordaan gu oidha' gu Kanaan gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen gu ma'nkam gu Gad ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees gu ñi'ook jodai maa'nkar Jawatan ju'ñdharan gu Jordaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam a'ga na ja'p gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen gu ma'nkam gu Gad ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees jodai maa'nkar Jawatan vupui bhaan gu oidha' gu Kanaan gu Jordaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jum daa'ñ bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Silo na ba' jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan.
Jano' ba' mɨjɨ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen gu ma'nkam gu Gad ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees gu oidha' gu Galaad gu Pinees gu mar gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' mambhɨɨx chiñia' bɨɨx; gio ba' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu vaak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx bopxi'ñ gu Israeel maa'n ka't mo'o ja'tkam vaak tattat gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen gu ma'nkam gu Gad ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees gu oidha' gu Galaad; gio ba' tu ñi'ook bham.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na ba' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu' na cham jir bhai' gu Peor cham dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm dhi' gu tanoolh ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gu' ka't gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu xibh bhaan bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Israeel.

Na tu' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu maa'nkar gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch; gu' cham bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tu' bhaan no'ch jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Akân gu mar gu Sera jix duñia' suudai' u'va daak bhaan bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Israeel mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen gu ma'nkam gu Gad ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees tu ñi'ook gui'p gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' uañi'ñ bhaan gu Jawatan Dios cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na ba' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu maa'nkar maa'nkar tai bhaan na ba' gu ñi'ook bhaan makgɨrxi'ñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' cham choo'n dhi' bham; gio ba' gu xibh gu ma'nkam maraa'n gu ma'nkam; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook namki' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen tu' gu ma'nkam gu Gad; gio ba' cham namki' gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam jix duu maraa'n gu ma'nkam cham gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook dhi' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duu jano' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan cham na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan tu' na ba' gu maa'nkar.

Gu' gu ñi'ook na ba' ka't chuut tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ aajim mi' dhɨr no'ch gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan bɨɨx gu ñi'ook maa'nkar tai bhaan bɨɨx gu ñi'ook makgɨrxi'ñdha' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham gu xibh gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook cham namki' baasɨ'n gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' no'ch tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' no'ch gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jix duu gu ñi'ook tattat cham na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan makgɨrxi'ñdha' gu ñi'ook na ba' jum duu chuut tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' cham pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan na ba' gu maa'nkar jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.

Jano' ba' tɨiñ gu Pinees jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan chiñia' gu ñi'ook ɨɨbhidham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel bɨɨx mi'p gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen gu ma'nkam gu Gad gu ma'nkam gu Manasees jix bɨɨx duu.

Ba' jix aa' gu Pinees gu mar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Eleasar gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen gu ma'nkam gu Gad gu ma'nkam gu Manasees; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch cham jix duñia' dhi' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jano' jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu Pinees gu mar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Eleasar chiñia' suulh bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Gad gu oidha' gu Galaad gu oidha' gu Kanaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix bhai' aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' cham tu ñi'ook jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan bhɨɨ'ñdham na ba' cham tu' duu gu oidha' oi'ñka' gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen gu ma'nkam gu Gad.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen gu ma'nkam gu Gad jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; na gu' chuut tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mui'x gu tanoolh mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jix maa jɨɨpi'ñka' gu Israeel bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ gu Josuee jix duñia' kia'mi'ñ gu tanoolh.
Ba' jix aa' jup tɨɨt bɨx gu Israeel daraa chiñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' tu' jix duñia' kia'mi'ñ gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' buupui bɨx gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bɨx dhi' chɨbɨɨp gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' bopxi'ñ dhi' chɨbɨɨp na ja'p dɨr gu Jordaan bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ' suudai' bhaan pai' gu tas jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook u'u kavɨk; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bia'ka' oi'ñga'n na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jix jai' nukadham duñia' bɨx ua'nak u'uan ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Moisees cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' kɨɨ'n tu'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk ba'k dhi' chɨbɨɨp jix duñia' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios tu'.
Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' tu' baas gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kavɨk gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook soo'mchulhdhak tu' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu vupui.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na ja'p jix aa'.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix jai' gu i'ii'ñ kai'chɨt gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' chɨbɨɨp jix duñia' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook tu' bɨɨx ba'k gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios cham dhi' chɨbɨɨp vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook; gio ba' va'k ka't jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n na ba' jo'ii' na ba' gu vupui bɨɨx ka'm jix bhai' gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' dhi' na ba' baakɨi gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu oidha'; gio ba' bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ cham tu' gu ñi'ook bɨx jix bhai' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr bɨx jix duñia' tɨbiap cham tu' gu ñi'ook tu'.

Gu' gu' ka't na ja'p tu' tɨbiap bhaan gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm cham tu' duu bhaan jix bhai' gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk bhaan ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia' jiimchu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu'; gio ba' i'iich gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu ñi'ook jix bhai' gu oidha' tu' jix maa.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Josuee bɨx bopxi'ñ gu Israeel gu Sikêm jup tɨɨt daraa gu Israeel chiñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Josuee bɨx gu ja'tkam; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr tattat jix daa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baasɨ'n gɨ' suudai' jiim maachim gu Taree gu taat gu Abraam gu Nakôr; jano' ba' tu juan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu taat gu Abraam baasɨ'n gɨ' suudai' jiim bɨx gu oidha' gu Kanaan gu Isaak.
Jano' ba' gu Isaak tu' gu Jakob gu Esauu; gio ba' gu Esauu tu' gu kavɨk gu Seir gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gu' gu Jakob gu ma'nkam jix dhaav gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ejipto tɨjɨɨ'ñ mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tattat gu Ejipto; gio ba' na ja'p gu gɨ' suudai' gu Egipkios bhiadat tattat bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ' suudai' gu Bermejo bɨɨx kavaayo.

Jano' ba' jix duu na ja'p duuñ gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaas gu tukgam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Egipkios tu' jix ai bhaan gu gɨ' suudai' jix bhaan dhaas; gio ba' gu vupui gu Ejipto; mi' dhɨr mui'x gu tanoolh oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Amorreos oi'ñka' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan bhaan gu ñi'ook; gu' tu' kapbhai' gu noobh gu oidha' vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix búup mi' dhɨr gu Balak gu mar gu Sepor gu gɨ'kora' gu Moabitas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Israeel; gio ba' bhañ tɨɨt gu Balaam gu mar gu Beor na ba'.
Ba' jix aa' gu' tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kai gu Balaam va'k jix bhai' aa' gu noobh.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jordaan gu Jerikoo; gio ba' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Jerikoo bhaan gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Amorreos gu Pereseos gu Kananeos gu eteos gu Gergeseos gu ebeos gu Jebuseos; jano' ba' tu' kapbhai' gu noobh.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan maachim gook gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos; gio ba' cham bɨɨx gu kuchii tu' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu' jɨ'dɨlh cham; gio ba' oidha' u'va cham gu ux na tu ibai'.
Jano' ba' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx tu'r; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tattat baasɨ'n gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Ejipto; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' tu' cham bhai' gu ñi'ook tu juan gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na pai' dhuuk tu' gu Jawatan Dios tattat na pai' dhuuk baasɨ'n gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Jawatan Dios gu Amorreos gu oidha'; na tu' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu juan gu Jawatan Dios.

Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios jix buusñi no'ch gu Dios tattat gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu vaak juantu'n; gio ba' vupui bhaan gu Dios gu vupui tu' gu ñi'ook dhi' buimɨk tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu bhóogɨt pai' bɨx gu ja'tkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan no'ch bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Amorreo jix daa gu oidha'; na gu' no'ch gio gu Jawatan Dios na gu' chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Josuee gu ja'tkam; na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu juan gu Jawatan Dios na gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix bhai'x; mi' dhɨr cham uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook mi' dhɨr tu' gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu ja'tkam jano' ba' gu Josuee; gio ba' cham va'k gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee jix aa' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' tu juan; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu'ch.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam jix aa' gu Josuee; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu jano' ba' gu Josuee ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu ja'tkam gu tanoolh jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Sikêm.
Jano' ba' ua'na gu Josuee dhi' gu ñi'ook u'uan ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' dhaagɨk jix gɨ' gu jodai jix búup bɨtaa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't ju'ñdharan xidhuu gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Josuee bɨx gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu jodai ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch ñi'ookdham tu' naak bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook bɨɨx no'ch; na gu' ka't ñi'ookdham bhaan gu ñi'ook na gu' cham bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Josuee gu ja'tkam maa'n gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' tu'x jix koi gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chamaam mambhɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu Timnat-sera gu kavɨk gu Epraim gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk gu Gaas.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Josuee bɨx gu ñi'ook daraa mi' dhɨr gu Josuee bɨx buimɨi gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sikêm o'oo gu Josee gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Ejipto baasɨ'n yooxi' gu Jakob gu ma'nkam gu emor gu taat gu Sikêm gu ñi'ook ali' karneer; gio ba' ka't gu maa'nkar gu ma'nkam gu Josee.
Jano' ba' gio jix koi gu Eleasar gu mar gu Aaroon; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Pinees gu mar ka't jix maa gu kavɨk gu Epraim.
